method.scope: Static analysis; pseudocode includes library functions, thunks and uncertain recovered types. Not recovered original source, not a verified rebuild.

confirmed_observations.finding: Initializer clears 0x9038 bytes; getter indexes records with stride 0x208. This is 71 configuration records of 520 bytes, not a claim of 71 player-selectable weapons. 2,127 literal initializer writes were extracted, but most field meanings and overrides remain undecoded.
confirmed_observations.comparison: Pocket Siege has compact hand-authored profiles. Expand behavior/state modeling only after relevant fields are verified.

confirmed_observations.finding: Mission loader routes Ammo_Shotgun and Delay_Shotgun through separate helpers with index 0xB. Ammo loader treats -1 as unlimited and adds finite amounts to existing finite ammo; delay loader writes a separate 16-bit value.
confirmed_observations.comparison: Pocket Siege has per-team ammo but no general per-weapon availability-delay configuration.

confirmed_observations.finding: Placement helper multiplies coordinates by 0x10000; related code shifts by 16. Candidate X is 32 + random modulo 1856. Collision-based placement searches are bounded at 75 attempts. Exact caller-specific placement semantics remain partially unresolved.
confirmed_observations.comparison: Pocket Siege uses floating-point world coordinates and fixed horizontal spawn anchors. Matching behavior requires tracing fixed-point rules and collision profiles, not copying constants into the current units.

confirmed_observations.finding: The extra context field is the completed logic frame counter (004a1a00). Logic RNG computes (state + frame) * 1664525 + 1013904223 in uint32 arithmetic. A separate visual RNG at 004ee930 omits the frame addition. Both initialize from the mission seed (0049ca90). Native executable test vectors verify both recurrences.
confirmed_observations.comparison: Pocket Siege now uses separate seeded gameplay and visual streams. Original caller masks, draw order and full frame dispatch remain unported.

confirmed_observations.finding: Mission options separately include WeaponsDontEndTurn, LossOfControlDoesntEndTurn, PauseTimerWhileFiring (default 1 in this loader), JetPackTimeLimit (default 20 here), destructibility and friction. These are loader defaults, not asserted standard-match defaults.
confirmed_observations.comparison: Pocket Siege hardcodes more of these interactions and uses fuel-based jetpack behavior.

confirmed_observations.finding: 29 terrain-theme archives contain separately named soil, grass, bridge pieces, background sprites, debris and object-placement metadata. Frontend code constructs landgen commands with bridges, water, generation, custom and mission modes. Presence of the command string does not prove an external landgen.exe is required or present.
confirmed_observations.comparison: Pocket Siege terrain is procedural but its object placement and terrain material system are much simpler.

confirmed_observations.finding: 788 .spr name strings, of which 591 begin with w. These are filename references, not independently decoded animations or frame counts. Examples include float/stand/drown transitions and up/down idle variants.
confirmed_observations.comparison: Pocket Siege has a small whole-body pose set; weapon-specific transitions and aim variants remain a large visual gap.

not_yet_verified: Weapon field meanings and final scheme-adjusted values
recommended_next_pass: Identify projectile and worm movement handlers and their virtual tables
Decode selected weapon records and validate consumers before porting constants
Trace simulation clock and fixed-point rounding
Add reproducible gameplay RNG and configurable weapon delays in original code, backed by tests
distribution: Executables, pseudocode and Ghidra project remain local and gitignored. At the user's subsequent explicit request, original SPR animations, sound effects and voice banks are now imported in public/armageddon. See armageddon-port.json for integration coverage.
